ssh_port.description: Port number on which the SSH daemon listens for connections.

address_family.description: IP address family: 'any', 'inet' (IPv4 only), or 'inet6' (IPv6 only).

listen_address.description: Specific IP address to bind to (e.g., '192.168.1.10'). Set to '0.0.0.0' for all interfaces.

password_authentication.description: Enable password authentication. Not recommended for production if SSH keys are used.

max_auth_tries.description: Maximum number of authentication attempts permitted per connection.

authentication_methods.description: Ordered list of authentication methods to accept (e.g., ['publickey', 'password']).

banner_file.description: Path to a file whose contents are displayed before authentication (e.g., '/etc/issue.ssh'). Leave empty to disable.

permit_user_environment.description: Allow users to set environment variables via ~/.ssh/environment.

client_alive_interval.description: Seconds between client alive messages (0 = disabled). Helps detect dead connections.

client_alive_count_max.description: Number of client alive messages allowed without response before disconnecting.

log_verbose.description: Include client IP address and other verbose details in logs.

startup_rate_limit.description: Maximum number of unauthenticated connections allowed per minute per IP.

ciphers.description: Ordered list of supported ciphers (strong algorithms only).

macs.description: Ordered list of supported MACs (Message Authentication Codes).

kex_algorithms.description: Ordered list of key exchange algorithms (modern & secure only).

protocol.description: SSH protocol version (must be 2 for modern security).

strict_modes.description: Require strict permissions on user's key files and home directory (prevents misuse).

x11_forwarding.description: Enable X11 forwarding (graphical apps over SSH).

gateway_ports.description: Allow remote hosts to connect to ports forwarded for the client.

sftp_subsystem.description: Command or path to the SFTP subsystem.

sftp_chroot_groups.description: List of groups whose members will be chrooted to their home directories upon SFTP login.

chroot_path.description: Absolute path to chroot directory (must be owned by root and not writable by group/others).
